packageRules.description: The SDK bundles the Claude Code CLI the runner launches, and the CLI version decides which models a runner can serve. Under the default strategy a new 0.3.x release already satisfies ^0.3.x, so Renovate proposes nothing and the lockfile stays on an old CLI while new models ship (Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 were both held back that way). Bumping the range moves the lockfile with every release.

Only plain rc tags (1.0.0-rc.N), never hash-suffixed snapshot builds such as rc.5-ab785fc, which ship without release notes. Pinned to an exact v1 rc, and always together: the migrator (packages/core/db/migrate-tree.ts, migrate-apply.ts) and the layout tools rely on properties of that rc's folder layout, snapshots and `check`, asserted by packages/core/__tests__/migration-layout.test.ts and apps/web/tests/db/migration-layout-v1.test.ts. A bump is a person's review of those two, never an automerge.

One Playwright version for the whole repo: each version owns one Chromium build and `playwright install` from another version deletes it. apps/runner/package.json is the pin the runner image reads; scripts/playwright-pin.test.ts fails on drift.
TypeScript 7 is a native-first rewrite that dropped lib/typescript.js; Next.js 16 can't detect it. Hold at 5.x until Next.js ships stable TS7 support.
